item.title: Version 1.6.0
item.description:
Catch-up with Claude Code 2.1.221–2.1.263.

  • Claude Fable 5.1 — now the current Fable model in the picker
  • Time & Locale — clock format (12-hour, 24-hour, 24-hour UTC) and IANA time zone
  • Prompt Cache TTL — Automatic, 5 minutes, or 1 hour
  • Inline output caps for shell commands and background tasks (bashOutputMaxChars, taskOutputMaxChars)
  • Continue automatically when a usage limit resets
  • Cross-session message handling (accept / hold / refuse) and dialog expiry
  • Spell checking for the prompt input, with checker and dictionary options
  • PreModelSwitch and PostModelSwitch hook events, plus 9 new environment variables
  • Fixed: claude-sonnet-5[1m] is a real model and was missing from the picker — Sonnet 5 does offer a 1M-context variant, unlike Fable.
  • Fixed: settings added in 1.5.0 and 1.5.1 could not be reliably cleared once set.

item.title: Version 1.5.1
item.description:
Catch-up with Claude Code 2.1.171–2.1.220.

  • Claude Opus 5 and Opus 5 (1M context) — Opus 5 is now Claude Code's default Opus model — plus Claude Sonnet 5
  • Dynamic Workflow Size picker (workflowSizeGuideline)
  • New Terminal & Accessibility section — screen reader mode, message timestamps, terminal progress bar, syntax highlighting, scrolling, and vim insert-mode escape sequences
  • New Agent View & Remote Control section — background agents, per-subagent status line, Remote Control and push notifications
  • Behavior: question timeout, file checkpointing (/rewind), todo panel, away recap, prompt suggestions, emoji completion, custom @ file-suggestion script, auto-compact window
  • Enterprise: MCP server allowlist, marketplace allow/blocklists, channels, Artifact tool, sideload flags, skill shell execution, deep-link registration
  • Sandbox: credential exposure, Apple Events, strict domain allowlist, denied domains, and filesystem-isolation bypass
  • Seven new hook events, including DirectoryAdded; iterm2 teammate mode; 14 new environment variables
  • Fixed: claude-fable-5[1m] was not a real model ID — Fable 5 has no [1m] suffix variant. Removed from the picker; existing configs still display as “Fable 5”.

item.title: Version 1.5.0
item.description:
• Claude Fable 5 joins the model picker as a fourth family (Fable 5, Fable 5 with 1M context, and the fable alias), in both the app and the menu bar switcher
  • Model picker now shows only current variants — legacy versions (Opus 4.7/4.6, Sonnet 4.5, Haiku 3.5) are hidden but still resolve to readable names in existing configs
  • New Fallback Models field — configure up to three models tried in order when the primary is overloaded (fallbackModel, Claude Code 2.1.166)
  • New Bundled Skills toggle (disableBundledSkills) and matching CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS environment flag (Claude Code 2.1.169)
  • New Ultracode Keyword Trigger toggle (workflowKeywordTriggerEnabled) next to Dynamic Workflows (Claude Code 2.1.157)
  • Environment: fable alias pin (ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL); HUD previews and placeholders refreshed to Fable 5

item.title: Version 1.4.0
item.description:
• Effort menu gains an Ultracode option, plus a Dynamic Workflows toggle (writes disableWorkflows)
  • HTTP/SSE MCP tool discovery now authenticates with the stored OAuth token, so auto-approval lists populate for servers like GitHub and NetSuite (previously HTTP 401)
  • Project-local MCP servers stored inline in ~/.claude.json are now shown and editable, saved back to the correct file
  • Many sections now live-reload on external file changes (MCP, sessions, stats, git, themes, profiles, storage badges, commands/skills/plugins)
  • Truthful data fixes: the Model picker no longer shows a fake “Sonnet” when none is set; session threads no longer drop your messages; saving sandbox/hooks/MCP/permissions no longer drops config keys (including per-server oauth)
  • Plugins badge counts installed plugins (not the catalog); Stats headline relabeled “I/O Tokens”; git detached-HEAD and renamed-file handling fixed; backups folder lists its files

item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description:
• MCP servers can now manage per-action auto-approval — each server lists its actions (discovered live via tools/list) with toggles that write mcp__server__tool rules to permissions.allow
  • “Auto-accept all actions” toggle approves an entire MCP server at once, including future actions
  • Added Claude Opus 4.8 (and 1M context) to the model picker; retired the deprecated Opus 4.0 / Sonnet 4.0 entries
  • Claude Code 2.1.142–2.1.154 catch-up: MessageDisplay hook, worktree.bgIsolation, disallowed-tools for commands, and enterprise settings (allowAllClaudeAiMcps, pluginSuggestionMarketplaces)
  • HUD previews and model-override placeholders refreshed to Opus 4.8

item.title: Version 1.2.3
item.description:
• Built-in theme previews now use accurate palettes resampled pixel-for-pixel from Claude Code's own rendering
  • Theme preview surfaces adapt — light themes render on white, dark themes on a dark background
  • Preset templates adopt a light or dark surface based on the app's appearance
  • Sidebar Themes badge now counts built-in themes plus custom files

item.title: Version 1.2.2
item.description:
• Tier 1 Claude Code catch-up (2.1.117–2.1.129): skillOverrides, prUrlTemplate, MCP alwaysLoad
  • New env vars in Environment view: CLAUDE_CODE_HIDE_CWD, DISABLE_UPDATES, ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_SERVICE_TIER, and others
  • Fixed startup freeze — subprocess execution in runShell no longer blocks executor threads (thanks @lemoran, #6)
  • Removed invalid “Auto” tag from effort pickers (valid scale is low/medium/high/xhigh/max)

item.title: Version 1.2.1
item.description:
• Added Opus 4.7 and Opus 4.7 (1M context) to the model picker
  • New Xhigh effort level between High and Max, matching Claude Code’s expanded intelligence scale
  • Project-level effort override now exposes the full scale (Auto/Low/Medium/High/Xhigh/Max)
  • HUD previews and environment placeholders refreshed to Opus 4.7

item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description:
• Stats dashboard redesign with Highlights card (streaks, active days, longest session, favorite model)
  • Friendly model names, no more <synthetic> in charts
  • Fixed token breakdown — Input vs Output primary, cache secondary
  • Settings load correctly — tolerant decoder for all JSON structures
  • Hooks display and edit properly — redesigned UI with sheet editor
  • Accurate storage and message counts
  • New app icon with correct brand color

item.title: Version 1.1.9
item.description:
• Stats dashboard redesign — new Highlights card with streaks, active days, longest session, favorite model
  • Friendly model names (Opus 4.6 instead of claude-opus-4-6), no more <synthetic>
  • Fixed token breakdown — Input vs Output as primary, cache stats as secondary
  • Top Projects now full width
  • New app icon

item.title: Version 1.1.8
item.description:
• Settings now load correctly — tolerant decoder handles missing/unknown JSON keys
  • Hooks display properly — fixed decoder for string matchers, timeout, new hook types
  • Redesigned hooks UI — collapsed empty sections, sheet editor with clear labels
  • Accurate storage stats — total includes all of ~/.claude/, message counts exclude events
  • No more defaults flash on navigation

item.title: Version 1.1.7
item.description:
• 13 CLAUDE.md templates organized by category (iOS, Android, Next.js, Python, Go, Rust, Monorepo, etc.)
  • Auto-backup before applying a template — restore from backup button in toolbar
  • Search now shows sub-sections and scrolls directly to the matched setting
  • Expanded search keywords — Fast Mode, shell, memory, voice, and many more now findable
  • Fixed settings reset on new install (guarded all onChange handlers)
  • Fixed sidebar ghost items and section headers during search
  • Fixed search crash when clearing text

item.title: Version 1.1.6
item.description:
• Fixed settings resetting to defaults on new install
  • App is now fully read-only on launch — only writes when you change something
  • Sparkle auto-updates
  • Sidebar can no longer collapse to zero width

item.title: Version 1.1.5
item.description:
• Sparkle auto-updates — check for app updates from General Settings
  • Sidebar fix — can no longer collapse to zero width
  • Updated release docs

item.title: Version 1.1.4
item.description:
• Notarized build — no more Gatekeeper warnings
  • Project-level settings editing with override toggles
  • Settings profiles — save and load configuration snapshots
  • Field-level saves — only the field you change is written to JSON
  • Fixed 1M context model IDs
  • Styled DMG installer
